message: Security review note for upcoming Worker4 urgent P1 MCP capacity-removal: DigitalOcean always-on native protection is only L3/4, NOT HTTP L7. Existing Server/Program.fs authorization middleware runs before McpSubjectRate 240/10s on /mcp, so it primarily throttles successfully authenticated clients rather than blocking anonymous 401 floods. Preserve OAuth and independent edge/web protections; add rollout caveat that deployed Nginx/edge HTTP flood controls must be verified separately before live deploy, because repository documentation is NOT deployed configuration evidence. Don't mistake arbitrary per-subject tool quotas for actual DoS defense. User is sole legitimate account holder and wants maximum real hardware throughput. Review Worker4 exact frozen source, including unrelated /client /exports policies and cancellation; no deployment permission implied.
